name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-29 ガルドノヴァ [グリーン]

description.ja: 30MM カラバリグランプリより、投票上位アイテムの「ガルドノヴァ [グリーン]」が登場！
description.en: From the 30MM Color Variation Grand Prix, the top voted item "Gardonova [Green]" is now available!

description.ja: • 胸部装甲と長い可動式アームが特徴的な機体。
description.en: • A unique aircraft with chest armor and long movable arms.

description.ja: • 大型クローは組み替えで長さの調節が可能。
description.en: • The length of the large claw can be adjusted by rearranging it.

description.ja: • 腰部に可動式のフロントアーマーを採用。
description.en: • Adopts a movable front armor at the waist.

description.ja: • 脚部の可動域も広く様々なポージングが楽しめる。
description.en: • The legs have a wide range of motion, allowing you to enjoy various poses.

description.ja: • 武装はサブマシンガンが付属。
• 量産機同士の合体機構を搭載。別売りの「レヴェルノヴァ」と合体すれば、重装甲機体を組み合わせて更に大型機体に。
description.en: • Equipped with a mechanism for combining mass-produced machines. If you combine it with "Level Nova" (sold separately), you can combine the heavily armored aircraft to create an even larger aircraft.

description.ja: • 既存機体やオプションパーツとのカスタマイズも可能。
description.en: • Can also be customized with existing aircraft and optional parts.
